title: Robust Latent Variable Graphical Models: Exact Recovery and Fundamental Limits
abstract: arXiv:2610.27010v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study robust estimation of a Gaussian precision matrix that decomposes as a sparse matrix minus a symmetric, possibly indefinite, low-rank matrix, a structure that arises when latent-variable marginalization is combined with conditioning on linear measurements. The proposed convex estimator replaces the sample covariance by the centered Gaussian measure-transformed (MT) covariance, which preserves the signed graph of the sparse component under the nominal model, and penalizes the low-rank component by the nuclear norm of a congruence transform, an atomic norm that encodes structural side information. Our main result is a primal--dual witness theorem: under restricted invertibility and irrepresentability conditions on the Fisher information, the raw convex optimizer is unique, has no false edges, recovers the signs of all sufficiently strong edges, and has exactly the true rank and inertia. translated_title: 鲁棒潜变量图模型：精确恢复与基本极限
translated_abstract: 我们研究高斯精度矩阵的鲁棒估计问题，该矩阵可分解为一个稀疏矩阵减去一个对称的、可能不定的低秩矩阵，这种结构出现在潜变量边缘化与线性测量条件化相结合的情形中。所提出的凸估计器用中心化的高斯测度变换（MT）协方差替代样本协方差，该协方差在标称模型下能够保留稀疏分量的带符号图结构，并通过一个合同变换的核范数惩罚低秩分量，这是一种编码了结构侧信息的原子范数。我们的主要结果是一个原始-对偶见证定理：在Fisher信息满足受限可逆性与不可表示条件的情况下，凸优化的原始解是唯一的，不产生虚假边，能够恢复所有强度足够高的边的符号，并且恰好具有真实的秩与惯性。这些条件可归结为图形化拉（截断）……
tldr: 本文提出了一种用测度变换协方差替代样本协方差、并用合同变换核范数惩罚低秩部分的凸估计方法，用于鲁棒估计具有“稀疏减低秩”结构的高斯精度矩阵，并在受限可逆性与不可表示条件下证明了精确恢复保证，包括解的唯一性、无虚假边、边符号恢复正确以及秩和惯性的准确恢复。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a convex estimator that replaces the sample covariance with a measure-transformed covariance and penalizes the low-rank part via the nuclear norm of a congruence transform, for robustly estimating Gaussian precision matrices with sparse-minus-low-rank structure, and proves exact recovery guarantees—including uniqueness, no false edges, correct sign recovery, and exact rank and inertia—under restricted invertibility and irrepresentability conditions.
